training: Two independent 4-thread CPU workers; identical batch schedule and update budgets.
norm_diagnostic: One exploratory 2-thread validation-only worker briefly overlapped training around update 570. This is why elapsed training time is not presented as a speed comparison.
inference_timing: Run only after all training and diagnostic workers complete.
primary_protocol_changes: None after training began. The norm diagnostic is separately labeled and never changes training or fresh-audit candidate selection.
